Account background:
- Mission: modernize a 24/7 government contact center that supports critical infrastructure operators (power grid control ops, emergency response coordination).
- Current stack: legacy ACD + custom NCIDS, ticketing via in-house system. No internet egress from secured zones.

Recent timeline (concise):
- 2025-11-06: Initial inbound via partner lead; AE Jordan Park assigned.
- 2025-12-09: Discovery call w/ program lead (Lt. Cmdr. R.). Asked for strict air-gap support; mentioned previous failed PoC with cloud vendor.

Requirements summary (from calls & notes):
- Primary workloads: low-latency agent_assist (live screen-pop + real-time summarization), ticket_summarization post-call, tool_calling to internal case management and operator consoles.
- Latency target: 200-400ms token latency for agent assist at ~800 concurrent agents during daytime peaks; 1s acceptable for longer summaries.
- Throughput target: sustain spikes up to 3x baseline for 2 hour windows (simulated incident surges).
- Reliability: graceful degradation -> deterministic fallback to local rules engine if model unavailable. No silent failures.
- Security/compliance: air-gapped private deployment only. KMS/HSM required, full audit logging of prompts and responses, automatic PII redaction for transcripts, retention controls (90d default, exportable on request).
- Tooling: must support authenticated tool-calling (OAuth2-like internal tokens), strict RBAC, and non-networked webhook adapters for internal orchestration.

POC scope & success criteria:
- Deliver an on-prem/air-gapped PoC: baseline model (quantized) deployed on local GPU rack, Redwood Private control plane mirrored in customer DMZ (no egress).
- Show real-time agent assist with <400ms median latency at 200 concurrent synthetic agents.
- Demonstrate ticket summarization pipeline: ingestion from local ticket store -> redact -> generate 3-line summary meeting readability/accuracy threshold (team will provide 50 sample tickets).
- Validate tool-calling: Redwood agent calls internal ticket system API within PoC network using signed tokens; confirm audit trail.
- Security sign-offs: InfoSec checklist items 1-12 closed (see linked doc).

- ARR expectation: $500k-$2M depending on full private deployment + 3-year support/maintenance.
- Procurement constraint: must integrate with customer KMS (HSM) and deliver reproducible offline installer for future updates.
